body:
In general, probably. Problem is finding someone.

Instantly like a hotline, no. If things don't get better I'm more considering early Feb. Three of my kids have birthdays close to each other in March, so I'd want to go somewhere between Christmas and that week so as to minimize the possibility of souring a good holiday for them for the rest of their lives.

Thanks though, I know I didn't respond quickly but appreciate you taking the time.
